title: YATI (Tiled importer)
summary: Imports Tiled maps (.tmx, .tmj) as scenes: a TileMapLayer per tile layer with a generated TileSet, and objects as Marker2D, Area2D, StaticBody2D, or Sprite2D.
useWhen: The user designs levels in the Tiled map editor and wants the saved .tmx or .tmj maps, with their .tsx/.tsj tilesets and images, to become Godot scenes in the project that reimport whenever the map is saved.
avoidWhen: Levels are painted with Godot's own TileMapLayer editor or generated in code; those need no importer.
